dogecoin.text: @Dogecoin_punk @CoinMarketCap 3/ You could pull your money out of Doge, and buy another crypto with good tech behind it, and that would be a true investment for your future. Not just a multiplication of your money because a bunch of other people are buying it at the moment.

@Dogecoin_punk @CoinMarketCap They're only millionaires if they sell. If they sell, the price goes down. If everyone stops buying and selling, the price still goes down because Doge is hyperinflationary. It's a lose-lose situation.

@Dogecoin_punk @Crankenst3in @error_cyber @CoinMarketCap Performance and the price going up are distinctions with a difference. People buying Doge don't know not to buy when the price peaks. That's not synonymous with "performance".
